purpose: Freeze grammar-aware native-thinking causal token sites for human review before any intervention runner consumes them.

classification_axes.site_axis: Per-event association plus actual rank-evidence/city surface order determines causal roles.
classification_axes.cohort_axis: Trajectory sequence source and trace completeness determine the estimand; they never move token sites.

cohort_policy.primary_rank_resolved_full_chain: rank_supported_episode plus one_to_one; eligible for retrieval, progress transition, terminal stop, and later serial mediation
cohort_policy.secondary_structural_marker_neutral: one_to_one structural fallback; marker-neutral/structural sensitivity, not pooled into primary rank-resolved effects
cohort_policy.secondary_structural_recap: structural extension of an earlier ranked episode; recap/consolidation sensitivity only
cohort_policy.secondary_local_partial_unique: local observed retrieval and continue transitions only; no correct terminal-count estimand
cohort_policy.occurrence_retrieval_only_duplicates: source retrieval at each emitted occurrence only; no unique-count/progress claim
cohort_policy.secondary_evidence_sequence_exploratory: exact unique coverage recovered from score-supported first mentions; exploratory retrieval, continue, and terminal stop; occurrence index is not rank evidence
cohort_policy.secondary_evidence_sequence_partial_expl: partial score-supported first-mention sequence; exploratory local retrieval and continue only; no terminal-count or rank-marker claim

estimand_eligibility.evidence_sequence_restriction: no rank-core, marker, or accumulator claim; compiler-assigned 1..M is occurrence bookkeeping only

semantic_site_policy.semantic_span_normalization: strip parser-edge Unicode whitespace from semantic item, city-unit, and rank-evidence surface; additionally strip edge punctuation from rank evidence when an alphanumeric core remains; retain all original/surface/core boundaries; do not trim city or Total:
semantic_site_policy.retrieval_transition: transition k -> k+1; every anchor scores exactly the same next-city token span, while intervening text is teacher-forced but not scored
semantic_site_policy.p0_item_end: last token of committed item k; earliest event-specific anchor for city k+1
semantic_site_policy.unit_pre_d1: token immediately before the target city-bearing semantic unit
semantic_site_policy.pre_marker_d1: token immediately before an explicit marker only when that marker precedes the target city
semantic_site_policy.post_marker: last marker-core token only when that marker precedes the target city
semantic_site_policy.post_open_delimiter: last token of a separable opening bracket or invariant bullet; fused delimiter/content tokens are explicit N/A
semantic_site_policy.record_clause_pre_d1: token immediately before the literal clause In the 2024 city score audit when present in the target event
semantic_site_policy.city_pre_d1: output token immediately before the first token overlapping the target city span
semantic_site_policy.block_pre_d1: token before the first compiled event; exploratory non-event-specific anchor, excluded from primary pooling
semantic_site_policy.anchor_equivalence: semantic roles resolving to one model token are one intervention with all aliases retained; they are never double counted
semantic_site_policy.city_target_span: smallest output-token interval overlapping the full registered city surface
semantic_site_policy.rank_evidence_core_span: tokens overlapping semantic ordinal/count content after whitespace and removable edge-punctuation normalization; causal marker state uses this span
semantic_site_policy.rank_evidence_surface_span: tokens overlapping the whitespace-trimmed parser evidence surface; retained for visible-surface removal controls and audit
semantic_site_policy.rank_visible_format_shell_tokens: tokens in rank_evidence_surface_span but outside rank_evidence_core_span; paired visible syntax/delimiter control, allowed to be empty
semantic_site_policy.pre_marker_state: output token immediately before the first token overlapping rank_evidence_core_span
semantic_site_policy.post_update_commit_state: last output token overlapping the selected event semantic span
semantic_site_policy.continue_to_next_city: all tokens after current commit through next-city end, with next-city-only tokens saved separately
semantic_site_policy.stop_to_answer_query_v3: all tokens after final observed commit through the independent answer_query_v3 boundary
semantic_site_policy.semantic_target_only: for retrieval-anchor localization, only the identical next-city token span enters the primary score; interstitial distance is retained as a diagnostic
semantic_site_policy.prompt_source_record: the frozen full prompt record span registered for the event city
